lines.say: Front squat or back squat. Which is better?
In a front squat, the bar sits on the front of your shoulders. That keeps your body more upright.
It hits your quads and glutes hard, and your upper back works to hold the bar up.
One study compared them. Muscle work was about the same. But the front squat put less compression on the knees.
One catch: people used less weight on the front squat, which explains part of that.
Form: elbows high, chest up, and sit down between your heels. If your elbows drop, the bar rolls.
Wrists hurt? Use a cross arm grip, or straps.
